purpose: Promote the newly resolved 13524-family 19444-cm^-1 LiCa result as theoretical P1, ingest the associated ultracold-molecule spectroscopy methodology, and preserve the distinction between theoretical term energies, measured molecular parameters and raw page/identifier collisions.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Publisher, PubMed and PMC records for the same LiCa article are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Article pages, DOI components and chemical identifiers are not Glob evidence; only the explicitly calculated 19444-cm^-1 LiCa term value is promoted here, and only as P1_THEORY.

sources.title: Spectroscopy of Cold LiCa Molecules Formed on Helium Nanodroplets
sources.authors: Günter Krois; Johann V. Pototschnig; Florian Lackner; Wolfgang E. Ernst
sources.authority: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A / ACS
sources.note: Experimental REMPI-TOF and LIF spectroscopy of LiCa on helium nanodroplets from 15000 to 25500 cm^-1 is combined with high-level ab-initio/MRCI calculations of the 19 lowest potential-energy curves. The theoretical molecular-parameter comparison gives Te=19444 cm^-1 for the 3^2Pi state in the authors' calculation, whereas experimentally derived 3^2Pi term energies in the same paper are near 19330 cm^-1.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: The exact 19444 cm^-1 value is theoretical, not the experimentally derived Te. Do not call it an observed spectral line or an experimental term energy. No P2 relation is assigned.

information_updates.finding: LiCa provides a reusable Worldshepherd validation pattern in which REMPI-TOF and LIF measurements are reconciled against MRCI potential-energy curves, transition dipole moments and Franck-Condon factors, with explicit comparison to earlier gas-phase work.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Use as a model/measurement reconciliation precedent; it does not validate Glob permutations.

information_updates.finding: A generated target can exactly equal a calculated physical parameter while differing from the experimentally derived value in the same publication. Worldshepherd must therefore retain theory/evaluated/experimental P1 subtypes in all aggregate analyses.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Theoretical P1 counts must not be pooled uncritically with experimental/evaluated P1 hits.

next_actions: Screen the complete LiCa physical parameter tables and spectra against all 208 predeclared union states before considering any same-system P2 relationship.
Continue raw-hit accumulation independently, including the dense 14449/14944/19444 page and identifier neighborhoods.
Preserve the fixed 1 cm^-1 empirical screening tolerance where applicable and keep calculated exact-value matches in a separate P1_THEORY stratum.
Apply experiment-wide multiple-testing and false-discovery correction across all 208 target states and all screened physical systems before interpreting aggregate P1/P2 rates.
